text: Sampling, production and freight handled end to end. Reference prices published, a cutting template with every quote, and a person on the other end of the quote — not a form that goes nowhere.
From brief to pallet in four steps
Send the pack shot, target quantity and where it ships. We reply with a structure and a price range.
A physical sample in your artwork, produced in 5–10 days. Nothing is committed before you hold it.
Artwork goes to plate, the run is scheduled, and we send press sheets before packing.
DDP or FOB, palletised, with photos and the material declaration per order.
A price curve, not a contact form

Every structure is priced against the same model: board, size, print, finish and quantity. Change the quantity and the unit price moves — so you can see where the break-even sits before you commit to a tooling cost.
— quoted per shipment, never buried in the unit price.
— one-time plate and die cost, shown before you submit.
Mailer box · 30×22×12 cm · kraft · full colour
Indicative, excludes freight. At 5,000 pieces the unit price is 44% lower than at 500. Final price confirmed after dieline review.
Say what the box is made of, in numbers
Recycled content, board weight, coating and end-of-life route are published per structure — because “eco-friendly” is not a specification.
MOQ 500 pieces per design for printed boxes. Unprinted stock ships from 100 pieces.
How much does a custom box cost?

At 500 pieces, a 9.5×9.5×4 cm rigid jewelry box is about $2.83 per unit and a 30×22×12 cm printed mailer box about $2.48. The unit price drops as quantity goes up — the quote builder shows the full curve for your size.
Stock styles ship in 1–15 days. Printed custom orders are scheduled after sample approval, usually 7–30 days depending on structure and finishing.
Do you handle the whole supply chain?
We coordinate sampling, production, inspection and freight with vetted suppliers, and charge an 8–15% sourcing fee on the order value.
Shenzhen, China. DDP to the US and EU is standard; FOB is available if you consolidate.
Start with the size you already know.
